title: Paul Gordan and Clebsch-Gordan: Source-Witnessed LaTeX and Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Paul Gordan / Clebsch-Gordan record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record contains source-witnessed German/Latin transcription and English translation working packets split out from the older mixed additional-author shelf.

Status at a glance. These are package-audited working drafts, not final critical editions. OCR is used only as a non-authoritative prose/block comparator; source renders and included scan witnesses remain the authority for formulas and mathematical readings.

Latest update. Adds Gordan_Abel17_p228_243_DE_EN_20260611.zip, covering Clebsch-Gordan Theorie der Abelschen Functionen source pp.228-243 / printed pp.206-221. The package includes current German and English TeX/PDF, cumulative Abelsche DE/EN TeX/PDF through source p243, current and cumulative source-scan witnesses, formula crops, page/equation/correction ledgers, render checks, and clean build logs. It also records a better-scan spot audit for earlier low-quality pages and corrects prior visual normalization of the source letter q as Greek rho in the p224-p243 cumulative area. The next continuation point is after source p243 in the Abelsche Functionen stream.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Adds Abel17 p228-p243, extending the cumulative Abelsche stream through source p243 / printed p221. The package reports clean current/cumulative builds, includes source scans/crops/ledgers, records better-scan spot checks for earlier low-quality pages, and keeps OCR scaffold material noncanonical.
